note: Status di stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); requirement punya status. Klik dari daftar furnished membuka layar detail submission yang menampilkan furnished hirer/driver's particulars dan documentary proof dengan unduh satu file atau semua (zip). Gap: 'owner/hirer's particulars' hanya berupa data submitter dari submission; data owner/hirer/driver terdaftar pada notice disembunyikan di layar detail ini. Demo remark menyebut cron Internet-Intranet sync; job Furnish Processing enabled=true di cron-schedules-prod.properties:305-306, nilai server sebenarnya cannot verify from repo. Isi blob documentary proof di Azure dan role pengguna cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Klaim: klik ke detail, furnished particulars, dan unduh documentary proof bisa dibuktikan. Owner/hirer particulars terdaftar pada notice belum tampil di layar ini; sebutkan sebagai gap

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The officer clicks a notice and the detail screen opens with the submission data
steps.detail: Link Notice No membuka #/notices/update/{noticeNo}/{txnNo} di tab baru (FurnishSummaryList.tsx:96-101; route App.tsx:152). UpdateForm memuat NOTICE_VALID dan FURNISH_APPLICATION by txnNo (UpdateForm.tsx:89-90) lewat POST furnishapplicationlist (NoticeContext.tsx:1170-1186). Akses API: furnishapplicationlist ada di mapping OCMS_NOTICE_DETAIL dan OCMS_OIC_FURNISH (api-authorization.properties:37,81); role per user cannot verify from repo.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The detail screen shows the owner/hirer's particulars
steps.detail: Layar detail mode UPDATE menyembunyikan seluruh grup 'Offence Info' termasuk tab Owner/Hirer/Driver Details (Form.tsx:116 `!isUpdate`, :166-182) dan Preview tidak merender NoticeDetails/OwnerDetails/HirerDetails/DriverDetails kecuali mode bukan UPDATE (Preview.tsx:57-88). Yang tampil hanya data dari submission: Submitter's Particulars (nama, ID, kontak, email, staff name Corppass; DecissionDetails.tsx:175-203, DecisionForm.tsx:201-244). Data owner/hirer/driver terdaftar milik notice (OwnerForm/HirerForm/DriverForm) hanya muncul di mode EDIT, jadi officer tidak bisa membandingkan di layar ini.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The detail screen shows the hirer/driver's particulars that were furnished
steps.detail: Bagian 'Furnished Hirer/Driver's Particulars' menampilkan nama, ID dan tipe ID, email, kontak, alamat (postal, blk, jalan, floor/unit, building), hubungan dengan owner, deskripsi hubungan, periode sewa, dan tiga jawaban questionnaire (DecissionDetails.tsx:206-285); form Update Decision menampilkan field yang sama read-only (DecisionForm.tsx:255-360).

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The detail screen lists the documentary proof that was submitted
steps.detail: useFurnishAttachment memanggil POST furnishapplicationdoclist dengan txnNo (useFurnishAttachment.ts:46-92; controller OcmsFurnishApplicationDocController.java:59-66) dan DecissionDetails mengelompokkan file per docType di bagian 'Supporting Documents' (DecissionDetails.tsx:289-299). Baris dokumen berasal dari sync dokumen job Furnish Processing; isinya cannot verify from repo.

steps.flow_file: User story (tidak ada di flow deck)
steps.step: The officer can download the documentary proof
steps.detail: Tiap file punya aksi download/preview yang memanggil POST furnish-downloads dengan txnNo + fileName (useFurnishAttachment.ts:97-130); tombol 'Download All' mengunduh semua file lalu menyusun attachments.zip di browser (DecissionDetails.tsx:37-52, 300-306). Backend memvalidasi txnNo alfanumerik dan fileName tanpa path traversal lalu membaca blob furnishapplication/{txnNo}/{fileName} dari container ocms-inter (OcmsFurnishApplicationDocController.java:85-130). furnish-downloads hanya ada di mapping OCMS_OIC_FURNISH (api-authorization.properties:83), tidak di OCMS_FURNISHED_LIST. Isi blob di Azure cannot verify from repo.
